body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 0915ea69cd8ca49eeb018fe14f3fd2f49548a001 -->
**Clean - ready** (test-only golden refresh; nothing built or run for this review)

**Scope:** the PR has one commit (`0915ea6`) and changes one file, `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_tool_editor.png`. No code changes.

**Pixel diff, old (`origin/main`) vs new (PR head):** both images are 1280x720 RGBA. 248 pixels differ, inside bbox x 41..1261, y 14..482.
- **228 pixels differ by 1 LSB in a single channel**, e.g. (119,123,130)->(119,123,129). They are scattered across text antialiasing (toolbar, browser, dialog, catalog). This is rasterizer noise and invisible.
- **20 pixels differ by 106 LSB**: a 2x10 block at x 1256-1257, y 473-482, which is the bottom of the properties panel's scrollbar thumb. Thumb grey (143,147,153) becomes track background (37,41,47), so the thumb is 10 px shorter.

**Cause:** a shorter thumb means the properties panel has more content. Since the golden was last rendered (`f441d38`), #178 (probe ops, merge `919f2fd`) added a catalog row, `PRB-0400` (touch probe), to `tools::catalog()`. That row is below the visible area, so only the scrollbar shows it.

**Visual check:** I viewed both images side by side. The dialog fields, labels, preview, catalog rows, browser tree and toolbar are identical. No widget is missing, garbled or moved, and nothing is laid out differently.

**Nit (no action needed):** the PR body puts the drift down to #244/#162. The scrollbar change comes from #178's new catalog entry. The body also calls the diff a 20-pixel sliver; that leaves out the 228 one-LSB pixels, which do no harm.
